info.description:
- The graduation thesis provides opportunities for students to consolidate, review and synthesize the knowledge they have learned during their time at school.

- Provides students with the opportunity to apply their knowledge in the real world of production and business. Promote the ability to think creatively, learn how to put the problem and solve the practical problems posed during the internship in the unit. Next to it; Students can participate in the analysis, research and problem-solving related to the discipline.

- Create opportunities for students to compare and apply the knowledge and skills learned in practice. KLTN helps students develop their ability to think creatively in order to adapt to the continuous change of society and the ability to research in order to actively seek new ideas and lifelong learning.
